reasons: 3 years of history, enough for a trend but not a long one.
expected.excluded_reason: Mineral fuels and oils. Ghana's traditional petroleum trade dominates any ranking it enters.
expected.explanation: Imports of Petroleum oils reached $1.50 billion in 2024. Value has grown over 2022 to 2024. Year on year the change was +25.0%. NLD supplied 67% of it, of 2 reporting partners. Supply is concentrated in few countries, which is a potential opening for an alternative supplier as well as a risk to buyers who depend on it. This is a signal rather than a recommendation: nothing here measures local production capacity, input costs, or whether anybody can compete on it.
limitations: No three year growth rate: the data spans 2 years (2022 to 2024) and a three year rate needs a reading from 2021.
No five year growth rate: the data spans 2 years (2022 to 2024) and a five year rate needs a reading from 2019.
Domestic production is not in this dataset, so the gap between local supply and demand cannot be established.
